title: Conditions/List (1001-1500)
html:
The list of all conditions in the game is split into the following pages so as to limit the size of each page:

  • Conditions/List (1-500)
  • Conditions/List (501-1000)
  • Conditions/List (1001-1500)
Condition Effects
Performing 'Old Time Battles'
  • Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.
Performing 'Sing for Me'
  • Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.
Performing 'The Power'
  • Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.
Performing 'The Queen's High Seas'
  • Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.
Perilous Stakes
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to all damage, but when it attacks it heals 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points.
Perilous Stakes
  • Affected entity's attacks deal an additional 15⁠⁠Psychic damage and heal 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points. The entity scores a Critical Hit when rolling a 15 or higher. The entity is Vulnerable to all damage.
Permanent Mind Sanctuary
  • While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
Petrified
  • Turned to stone. Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions.
Phantasmal Force

Haunted by an echo of the last thing that attacked them.

  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage each turn.
  • When the target takes damage from another source, Phantasmal Force changes to that damage type.
  • At the end of each turn, the target makes an  Intelligence Saving Throw. On a success, the condition ends.
Phantasmal Killer
  • Affected entity is haunted by its worst nightmares.
  • It takes 4d10⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn, cannot move, and has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
Phase Optimizer Active
  • The affected entity gains an additional action.
Pierce the Weak
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.
Pinched
  • Take 1d4⁠⁠Piercing damage at the beginning of each turn and Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).
Pinned
  • Pinned under a beam.
Pinned Down
  • Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).
Pixie Blessing
  • The Shadow Curse cannot affect this creature thanks to a pixie's protective magic.
Plant Growth
  • The ground is covered with plants and weeds. Movement Speed is quartered.
Poison Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Poison damage. Can no longer be  Poisoned.
Poison Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Inflicts 3d6⁠⁠Poison every turn until a successful  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Poisoned
  • Deals 3d6⁠⁠Poison per turn
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • At the beginning of the turn, makes a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw to end the condition on success.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Ends on a successful  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of the turn.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Poisonous Fumes
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage per turn.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Polma's Wrath
  • Polma is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2.
Polymorph
  • You are now a particularly ripe wheel of cheese, unpleasant to the nostril.
Polymorph Self
  • Transformed into a blue jay, able to  Fly for 5 rounds.
Polymorphed
  • Creature is turned into a harmless sheep with 3 Hit Points for 5 turns.
  • If the sheep's Hit Points are reduced to 0, the creature reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.
Polymorphed
  • Changed into a beast.
Polymorphed: Dire Raven
  • Polymorphed into a Dire Raven
Poor Performance
  • Maybe you'd better stop, before anyone starts throwing rocks.
Possessing
  • The affected entity cannot be targeted by spells or attacks until the creature it has  Possessed dies or is  Turned.
Potent Mist Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist, now immune to all non-magical damage and resistant to magical damage.
  • Possibly  Blind foes within 4 m (13 ft) and inflict 3d6⁠⁠Necrotic at the start of their turn.
  • This condition is removed by sunlight.
Potion of Angelic Relief
  • Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Short Rest and all 1st and 2nd level spell slots are restored.
  • If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects will not apply.
Potion of Angelic Slumber
  • Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Long Rest. If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects do not apply.
Potion of Glorious Vaulting
  •  Jump distance is tripled
Precision Attack

Affected entity has a bonus to its next weapon Attack Roll equal to its Superiority Die

Predator Essence
  • Each Predator Essence heals the Houndmaster for 4d10⁠⁠Hit Points. Moreover, he deals an additional 4d10⁠⁠necrotic when he casts  Grave Shot.
Prepared
  • Deals an additional [Strength modifier]⁠⁠SlashingDRS damage with melee attacks.
Prey Essence
  • Grants 30 temporary hit points
Prime Target
  • You have drawn Grym's ire.
  • Grym will attempt to attack this creature if possible.
Produce Flame
  • A flickering flame sheds light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius around the creature.
Profane Womb-Bound
  •  Silenced and held in place by a Profane Womb.
Profoundly Intoxicated
  • Thisobald is on the verge of passing out from his heavy drinking.
  • He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and his hallucinations continue.
Projected Image
  • This magical projection cannot be targeted or attacked.
Promise of Wealth
  • Affected entity has been marked as wealthy by a follower of Mammon. Creatures with Infectious Greed have Advantage on Attack Rolls against it.
Prone
  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.
Prophecy: A Blunt Tool
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Bludgeoning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: A Little Help
  • Casting an Conjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: A Little Prick
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Piercing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Burn After Reading
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Fire to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Changes
  • Casting an Transmutation spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Cutting Edge
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Slashing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Dead Right
  • Casting an Necromancy spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Delivering Alms
  • When you  Help an ally, you will gain a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Evocative
  • Casting an Evocation spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Feign Surprise
  • Casting an Illusion spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Forceful Insistence
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Force to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Frosty Reception
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Cold to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Grave Fate
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Necrotic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Guarded
  • Casting an Abjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Headache
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Psychic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Holy Epiphany
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Radiant to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Melting Pot
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Acid to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Predictable
  • Casting an Divination spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Reap Rewards
  • Dealing the killing blow to an enemy will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Shocking Revelation
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Lightning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Spellbinding
  • Casting an Enchantment spell will result in a new Portent Die.
Prophecy: Thunderous Applause
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Thunder to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Venomous Words
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Poison to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
Prophecy: Well-Read
  • Learning from or using a Spell Scroll will result in a new Portent Die.
Protection from Energy: Acid
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Acid damage
Protection from Energy: Cold
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Cold damage
Protection from Energy: Fire
  • Has resistance to ⁠Fire damage
Protection from Energy: Lightning
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage
Protection from Energy: Thunder
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage
Protection from Evil and Good
  • The target is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. These creatures have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against the target.
  • Can't be  Frightened, or  Possessed.
Protection from Poison
  • All previous Poisonous effects afflicting the target are neutralized
  • Target gains  Advantage on  Saving Throws against being Poisoned
  • Target gains Resistance to ⁠Poison damage
Prowling
  • Stalking its prey. While  Invisible, the affected entity's next attack deals additional 1d8 damage.
Prying Heart
  • Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.
  • To end this effect, the creature must deny its Prying Heart by  Poisoning itself.
Psionic Drain
  • Your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores are reduced by 2 while Ptaris drains your mind to form a Mental Image. If any ability score reaches 0, you die. Destroying the Mental Image releases the psionic energy and ends this effect.
Psionic Enrichment
  • After using a tadpole power, affected entity gains  Advantage on all attacks for 3 rounds.
Psionic Visages
  • Affected entity is immune to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage while a Psionic Visage stands.
  • When the caster is struck, a visage will shatter, striking the attacker directly with 2d6⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Psionic Ward
  • Affected entity has a +5 bonus to  Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened while within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Psionic Ward Aura
  • The gish and allies within 3 m (10 ft) have a +5 bonus to Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened.
Psionic Weakening
  • Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving Throws. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Psychic Rend
  • Mentally in shambles. Has Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Saving Throws.
Psychic Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Psychic damage.
Psychically Dominated
  • This dragon is being controlled by the deep, twisting grasp of the Netherbrain's psychic might.
Ptarian Pacifism
  • Affected entity's Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores have been reduced by 4.
  • It and nearby allies are  Pacified. Unless the  50 temporary hit points granted by this effect are removed, when the effect ends, one of Ptaris' Mental Image will appear.
Punish Divinity
  • When hit with ⁠Radiant damage, Raphael can use a reaction to stun the attacker, leaving the impudent creature  Soul Wrenched
Purple Worm Toxin
  • Affected entity takes 1d10⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Pursuit Protocol
  • You attacked a Steel Watcher. The Steel Watch are searching for you across the city.
Qua'nith: Alert Active
  • Voss's psionic detector has warned you of an imminent githyanki attack. You gain a +5 bonus to your initiative check and have Advantage on your next Attack Roll.
Quickening Incantation
  • You can cast Illusion and Enchantment Spells as a bonus action.
Quickly Ticking Mine
  • This grenade will explode on the end of its turn!
Quickspell Flinger
  • Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead.
Radiant Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Radiant damage.
Radiant Retort
  • Whenever you take ⁠Radiant damage, reflect it back at your attacker twofold as ⁠Force damage.
Radiating Orb
  • Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it.
  • Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack.
Rage
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and while throwing objects.
  • Has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.
Rage
  • Deals an additional 2 + 1d4⁠⁠Slashing[See Notes] damage with melee attacks.
  • Is  Enlarged[See Notes].
  • Has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • Can use  Frenzied Strike (Boar).
  • Rage ends early if the boar didn't attack an enemy or take damage since its last turn.
Rage Impeded
  • Weighed down by Heavy Armour. Until the armour is removed, Raging won't grant extra damage, resistance to physical damage, or  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
Rage: Bear Heart
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Eagle Heart
  • Can use  Dash as a  Bonus Action, and foes have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Elk Heart
  • Movement speed increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Primal Stampede.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Tiger Heart
  • Jump distance increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Tiger's Bloodlust.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart
  • Can use  Inciting Howl and allies have  Advantage on melee  Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft).
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart's Prey
  • Standing near a Raging Wolf Heart barbarian.
  • The barbarian's allies have  Advantage on melee  Attack Rolls against this creature.
Raging Vortex
  • Affected entity is  Silenced and is being dealt 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn while remaining in the vortex.
Rallied
  • Granted  8 temporary hit points by a friendly combatant's rallying cry.
Rallied
  • The galvanising word and will of Duke Ravengard runs hot through your veins - granting you 30 temporary hit points.
Rampage
  • When a gnoll Downs a creature with a melee attack on its turn, it regains 1 bonus action and half of its movement speed.
Rampart Aura
  • All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.
Rapport Spores
  • Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another. Does not have a mechanical effect.
Rapture
  • Has a +1d6 bonus to Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws. Until next long rest.
Ray of Frost
  • Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).
Reactive Restoration
  • When  Blinded,  Paralysed, or  Poisoned, the affected entity is automatically  Restored.
Ready to Parry
  • The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 10.
  • The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.
Ready to Parry
  • The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 20.
  • The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.
Reaper's Reward
  • Consumed a necromite's soul and gained the ability to cast  Finger of Death
Reapply Hex
  • Can cast Hex without expending a new spell slot.
Recast Speak with Dead
  • Can recast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.
Recharging
  • This device cannot fire this turn.
Reckless Attack
  • You have  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but enemies also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you.
Reckless Roar

Creature has  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but its attackers also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against the creature

Reckless Warcry
  • Strength is increased by 3, while  Armour Class is decreased by 1.
Reconfigured: Undead
  • The foulest stench is in the air...
Recovering
  • Thisobald has had enough of his own concoctions - for now. Soon the numbness will set in once more, and the cycle will start all over again.
Reduced
  • Size is reduced.
  • Weapon attacks deal 1d4 less damage. Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Carrying Capacity is reduced by 25%
Reduced
  • Size is reduced.
  •  Armour Class increased by 5
  • Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks deal 1d4 less damage.
Reeling
  • Recovering from receiving a terrible blow or hitting a strong metal. Has a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.
  • Reeling has a maximum Duration: 10 turns.
Reflective Mucus
  •  Armour Class is increased by 2, and reflects the first projectile flying towards it back at the attacker, after which the mucus is removed.
Reflective Shell
  • Projectiles targeted at this creature are reflected back to their point of origin.
Reflectoguard Active
  • Any projectile fired at this character is sent back to where it came from.
Refreshed
  • Hit Point maximum increased by 10 until the next Long Rest.
  • Turns into  Nauseated after a Long Rest or after  Auntie Ethel turns hostile.
Refreshed
  • Suddenly feeling a lot better.
  • Removes  Feverish,  Filth Fever,  Rotting, and  Flesh Rot.
Regeneration
  • The Wood Woad regains 10⁠⁠Hit Points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.
Rejuvenating Miasma
  •  Animate Dead doesn't require a corpse in this area due to a lingering necrotic stench.
Relentless Avenger
  • You have a 4.5 m (15 ft) bonus to your Movement Speed
Rended Flesh
  • Affected entity can't be healed.
Repair Matrix
  • At the start of its turn, restorative servos heal this Steel Watcher for 3d8⁠⁠Hit Points.
Resistance
  • Gains a +1d4 bonus to  Saving Throws.
Resistant to Acid Damage
  • Acid damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Acid Damage
  • Acid damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Cold Damage
  • Cold damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Fire Damage
  • Fire damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Fire Damage
  • Fire damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Lightning Damage
  • Lightning damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Lightning Damage
  • Lightning damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Necrotic Damage
  • Necrotic damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Poison Damage
  • Poison damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Radiant Damage
  • Radiant damage against this entity is halved.
Resisted the Song
  • The affected entity succeeded a  Saving Throw against the harpy's  Luring Song and is immune to the effects for 2 turns.
Resonating Ki
  • The ki within the affected entity is resonating with a monk's. The monk can use  Ki Resonation: Blast to make it explode.
Restrained
  • Cannot move.  Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's  Attack Rolls and  Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage
Retributive Justice
  • This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.
Retributive Justice
  • This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.
Retributive Justice
  • This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.
Revealed

Affected entity lost its  Invisibility due to the effects of  See Invisibility.

Reverberation
  • Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws per remaining turn.
  • When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4⁠⁠ThunderDRS damage and must succeed a  DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or fall  Prone. The condition is removed afterward.
  • Creatures Immune to ⁠Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation.
Revitalising Gore
  • Affected entity is drenched in its enemies' blood. It regains 2d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
  • At level 10, the healing is increased to 4d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
Righteous Clarity
  • Has their Proficiency Bonus added to their  Attack Rolls.
Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill
  • As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.
Ritual Component
  • Astarion is Incapacitated as part of a profane ritual until Helped.
Ritual Drain: Astarion
  • Has an additional bonus action after draining Astarion's life force. This effect can only apply once per round.
Ritual Drain: Violet
  • The creature has an additional +5 to its Armour Class after absorbing Violet's strength.
Ritual Drain: Yousen
  • The creature gains 3d8⁠⁠Hit Points every turn while drawing on Yousen's vitality.
Ritual Sources
  • For each ritual source, your movement increases by 1 m (3 ft), you receive  10 temporary hit points and your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d10⁠⁠Necrotic damage, after draining a vampire spawn's life force.
Roiling Hellfire
  • Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Rolan's Mage Armour
  • Grant a creature a rudimentary defensive boost, increasing its  Armour Class by 2.
Rotten Reflux
  • Necrotic damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Rotting Regurgitation.
Rotting
  • Open wound is starting to rot.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the condition expires from duration. Failure will lead to you gaining  Flesh Rot.
Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Thunder damage.
  • Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast  Shatter and  Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest.
Ruptured
  • Take 1d4⁠⁠Piercing for each 1 m (3 ft) movement. Each time the damage is triggered, reduce the condition duration by 1.
Sacred Defiance
  • Affected entity has  Advantage against the effects of  Turn Undead while near the spellcaster.
Sacred Defiance Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby undead have  Advantage against the effect of Turn Undead.
Sacred Flame
  • The affected entity sheds light in 1.5m radius. It cannot become  Invisible. Enemies are more likely to target this character during the trial.
Sacred Munitions
  • Affected entity's ranged weapon attacks possibly inflict  Turn Undead on a target.
Sacred Weapon
  • Wielder's Charisma Modifier is added to Attack Rolls made with this weapon.
  • The weapon has become magical and emits light.
Sacrificed Soul
  • The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and attacks against it have  Advantage while the creature that sacrificed its soul is alive.
Sacrificial Lamb
  • Entity can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while enveloped in vampiric magic.
  • If Cazador draws power from all the spawn bound this way three times, he will ascend.
Sanctuary
  • Affected entity can't be targeted by enemy attacks or spells. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. Condition ends if the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, and will receive Sanctuary Blocked for 1 turn.
Sanctuary Blocked
  • Affected entity can't receive  Sanctuary
Sanctuary of Loss
  • The Nightbringer's dark arcana stops this entity being directly targeted by spells or attacks until it takes a harmful action.
  • Areas of effect can still harm this entity.
  • Viconia can still use  Heartwrench and keep this protection.
Sapped

Target has been psionically drained.

Sapping Curse

This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer.

  • Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Target is cursed.
Savage Howl
  • Movement Speed increased by 5 m (17 ft).
  • Gains  20 temporary hit points
Scarlet Remittance
  • Affected entity has +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.
Scarlet Remittance
  • Affected entity has +2 bonus to  Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.
Scarlet Remittance
  • Affected entity has +3 bonus to  Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.
Scarlet Saturation
  • Your next attack is guaranteed to Critically Hit.
Scarlet Stupor
  • The next creature to roll a  Saving Throw against one of your spells has  Disadvantage.
Scorching Aura
  • Attacks dealt by this entity deal a bonus 1d6⁠⁠Fire unless it is made  Wet.
Scorching Siphon
  • A nearby fire myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Fire damage and an additional 3d8⁠⁠Fire damage to  Elemental Retort.
  • The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Fireball and an additional  Reaction per turn.
Scratch's Sniff
  • Scratch has discovered something of note nearby.
Sea Plague
